title: Demonstration outside the Djibouti embassy in Brussels concerning Yacoub Omar Ali's reported detention
reason: The public gathering occurred in Brussels, Belgium, outside the territory of the Djibouti country unit; the available article also says only 'several dozen' and does not establish a 50-person threshold.
notes: The demand concerned release from detention in Djibouti, but the arrest preceded the gathering and is not coded as a response to that demonstration. Preserve as a foreign-location lead only.
